subject: Planning: SummitWorks x Redwood co-hosted webinar + conference booth collaboration
messages:
From: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@summitworks.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partnerships@summitworks.io
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Co-marketing proposal: joint webinar + booth activation

Hi Camila,

Hope you’re well — I’m Ryan (partnerships lead at SummitWorks). We’ve been following Redwood’s work on inference runtimes and think there’s a strong audience overlap for a co-hosted webinar and a shared booth at DevConf (Sept 28-30). Quick proposal:

- Webinar topic: "Scaling LLM inference in production — cost and latency tradeoffs" (45 min talk + 15 min live Q&A)
- Target date: week of Aug 24 or Aug 31 (ideal for pre-DevConf momentum)
- Audience: infra engineers, platform/ML infra leads, product engineering managers
- Mutual asks: 1 speaker from SummitWorks, 1 speaker from Redwood; joint social promotion; 3–4 targeted outreach emails to both lists

We can contribute a modest paid social budget (~$1k) and handle registration pages. Would Redwood be open to splitting content production and sharing decks? If so, can we loop in your marketing/ops folks to lock dates and a go-to-market checklist?

Attaching a short sponsorship one-pager for our proposed booth layout.

Best,
Ryan
SummitWorks Partnerships
[Attachment: SummitWorks_Booth_OnePager.pdf (PDF)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-marketing proposal: joint webinar + booth activation

Thanks Ryan — this sounds like a great fit.

We’re interested in the webinar during the week of Aug 24 if you can do Aug 25 or 26 (those dates give us a good runway to promote ahead of DevConf). A couple quick Qs so we can scope:
- Do you have a target registrant number or ICP breakdown (enterprise vs startups, job titles)?
- Who would be SummitWorks’ speaker(s) and do you have a short bio?
- Are you proposing we co-produce a single deck or separate talk tracks?

Looping in Marissa (marketing) and Sergio (partnerships) to confirm promotion cadence, asset needs, and to discuss booth-specific asks for DevConf. Laura — FYI from sales leadership perspective; we may want to leverage the event for a small Partner-led exec happy hour.

If Aug 25 works I’ll tentatively book the window 10:30–11:30 PT and draft a mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0198

Subject: RE: Co-marketing proposal: joint webinar + booth activation — marketing checklist

Great to meet you Ryan — excited about the joint program. A quick marketing checklist from Redwood side and timeline: 

Must-haves (we can own these items but need assets from SummitWorks):
- Speaker bios + headshots (high-res) — due Aug 14
- Company logos (SVG + PNG) — due Aug 14
- Short description (1–2 paragraphs) and 3 bullet takeaways — due Aug 14
- Landing page copy + registration form (MarCom owns page) — draft by Aug 17
- Joint promotional calendar: 2 email sends + 3 social posts per org + 1 blog teaser — deploy Aug 18–24

Optional add-ons if SummitWorks can commit: sponsored social ($1k budget OK), co-branded webinar ad, and if we confirm booth presence, a pre-event joint blog to drive traffic.

Attached: Redwood Webinar_Marketing_Playbook (templates, sample CTAs, speaker checklist).

Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@summitworks.io>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Co-marketing proposal: booth + webinar sync — logistics & ask list

A few practical notes from ops/partnerships: 

1) Booth coordination (DevConf): if we’re pairing booths, we should agree on signage, shared lead capture form, and a lead-handshake SLA (who follows up on what tier of lead). Proposal: Redwood owns follow-up for enterprise leads, SummitWorks owns product trials.
2) Speaker reimbursement / travel: will SummitWorks cover their speaker travel or do we split? If both speakers are remote, we should confirm A/V test windows.
3) Measuring success: registrants, live attendees, MQLs, and 60-day post-event POCs. Can we agree on target KPIs so marketing can measure?

I can draft a 1-page mutual action plan after we confirm date.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
